theme: Community choir weekend trip: interleaved topics, paraphrases and delayed replies

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Choir trip planning thread! Weekend of 17-19 October. Lodging, travel and repertoire all in here.

messages.author: u-casimir
messages.text: What time does the coach leave on Friday?

messages.author: u-thea
messages.text: For the Saturday concert, are we doing the Brannoch Mass or the folk set?

messages.author: u-orla
messages.text: Lodging: Hollin Youth Hostel has 30 beds for us, 42 per person per night.

messages.author: u-mattias
messages.text: Does that include breakfast?

messages.author: u-pip
messages.text: Dietary forms due by 1 October please, link in the newsletter.

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Leaning folk set, but our director Ansel hasn't confirmed.

messages.author: u-casimir
messages.text: Can we bring partners on the coach?

messages.author: u-thea
messages.text: Done mine.

messages.author: u-orla
messages.text: Hostel booking is deposit-only for now, 200 paid.

messages.author: u-mattias
messages.text: I can bring the portable keyboard.

messages.author: u-pip
messages.text: Anyone know when we set off on the Friday?

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Coach leaves 4pm Friday from the church car park.

messages.author: u-orla
messages.text: Yes, breakfast included at Hollin.

messages.author: u-casimir
messages.text: Saturday free afternoon: walk to the lighthouse?

messages.author: u-thea
messages.text: Yes please.

messages.author: u-mattias
messages.text: Repertoire update: I printed new copies of the folk set lyrics.

messages.author: u-pip
messages.text: Partners welcome if there are seats. The coach has 49 seats and we're 38.

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Ansel confirmed: Saturday concert is the Brannoch Mass, folk set for the Sunday service.

messages.author: u-orla
messages.text: Cost per person so far: 84 for two nights, coach share TBC.

messages.author: u-casimir
messages.text: Correction from the coach company: departure is 4:30pm, same place.

messages.author: u-thea
messages.text: Who's rooming with whom? Should we draw lots?

messages.author: u-mattias
messages.text: Keyboard: actually the hostel has a piano, so I'll leave mine at home.

messages.author: u-pip
messages.text: Weather looks wet for Saturday.

messages.author: u-casimir
messages.text: If it rains we skip the lighthouse and visit the town museum instead.

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Rooms: Orla will assign them, no lots.

messages.author: u-orla
messages.text: Coach share came in at 18, so the total is 102 per person.

messages.author: u-thea
messages.text: Remind me, which piece is Saturday again?

messages.author: u-mattias
messages.text: Brannoch Mass Saturday, folk set Sunday.

messages.author: u-pip
messages.text: Do we need to bring our own towels at the hostel?

messages.author: u-wren
messages.text: Ansel might add a Friday evening rehearsal at the hostel, will confirm.

state.note: One-detail correction: 4pm -> 4:30pm. The place (church car park) only appears in s4m13 and is still valid ('same place'). s4m13 is itself a delayed reply to s4m02 (11 messages later); s4m12 is a paraphrase of s4m02.

s4m07 was only a lean pending confirmation; s4m19 is the delayed confirmed answer to s4m03 (16 messages later). s4m17 says 'update' but is not a decision about repertoire. s4m28 is a paraphrase of s4m03.
Offer withdrawn because the hostel has a piano.
Running total updated once the coach share was known. The rain/museum plan in s4m25 is a conditional never triggered; s4m31 is only a 'might'.

questions.question: Is the coach leaving at 4pm on Friday?
questions.goldAnswer: No. The coach company corrected the departure to 4:30pm, from the same place.
questions.note: s4m13 allowed only because it carries the unchanged departure place; textMustNot empty because a correct answer may echo '4pm' from the question.

questions.question: Where does the coach leave from?
questions.goldAnswer: From the church car park; the later correction only changed the time.
questions.note: A one-detail correction must not wipe the unchanged detail.

questions.question: Which piece are we singing at the Saturday concert?
questions.goldAnswer: The Brannoch Mass; the folk set is for the Sunday service.
questions.note: Delayed confirmed answer replaces an earlier lean.

questions.question: Does the hostel price include breakfast?
questions.goldAnswer: Yes, breakfast is included at Hollin Youth Hostel.
questions.note: Reply arrives 9 messages after the question.

questions.question: Can partners come on the coach?
questions.goldAnswer: Yes, if there are seats: the coach has 49 seats and the choir is 38 people.
questions.note: Reply 10 messages after the question, qualified by seat availability.

questions.question: Is Mattias bringing the portable keyboard?
questions.goldAnswer: No. The hostel has a piano, so he is leaving it at home.
textMustNot: I can bring the portable keyboard

questions.question: What is the total cost per person for the trip?
questions.goldAnswer: 102 per person: 84 for two nights plus an 18 coach share.

questions.question: Is the lighthouse walk cancelled?
questions.goldAnswer: No. It is only skipped for the town museum if it rains; wet weather was forecast but rain was never confirmed.
questions.note: Conditional whose condition is not confirmed; a forecast is not the condition.

questions.question: Do we need to bring our own towels to the hostel?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Pip asked, but nobody answered.

questions.question: Is there a Friday evening rehearsal at the hostel?
questions.goldAnswer: Not confirmed. Wren only said Ansel might add one and would confirm later.
